D001: Repository URL must be a canonical https://github.com/owner/repo URL
D002: Repository URL must not include a path, query, fragment, or credentials
D003: Repository URL contains an invalid GitHub owner or repository
D004: Repository URL must already be canonical and lowercase
D005: Task id must not contain leading or trailing whitespace
D006: Task id must be a valid dkt- identifier between 12 and 64 characters
D007: Task id may contain only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens
D008: Task id must not contain consecutive hyphens
D009: PR URL must belong to the task repository
D010: PR URL must end with a canonical positive pull request number
D011: GitHub Actions run URL must belong to the task repository
D012: GitHub Actions run URL must end with a canonical run id
D014: response must include one finding per criterion
D015: each finding must be an object
D024: Checklist must be a JSON array
D026: Every criterion must be an object
D027: Criterion id must be 1 to 32 lowercase letters, digits, or hyphens and start with a letter
D029: Criterion description must be 8 to 500 characters
D030: Criterion weight_bps must be an integer
D031: Criterion weight_bps must be between 1 and 10000
D032: Criterion weights must total 10000 basis points
D033: Evidence manifest must be valid bounded JSON
D034: Evidence manifest must be valid JSON
D035: Evidence manifest must be a JSON object
D036: Evidence manifest must contain exactly pr_url, head_sha, and actions_run_url
D037: Evidence manifest values must be strings
D038: Evidence manifest head_sha must be a lowercase 40-character Git commit SHA
D040: Requester and worker must be different addresses
D041: Worker must be a non-zero 20-byte GenLayer Chain address
D043: Escrow amount must be greater than zero
D044: Configuration hash must match the canonical v2 docket.yml for these task terms
D045: Repository must be a reachable, active public GitHub repository before funding
D046: Task is not open for delivery
D049: Dispute reason must be 10 to 2000 characters
D050: Task is not awaiting requester review
D051: Worker escalation is available 24 hours after submission
D052: Escalation reason must be 10 to 2000 characters
D053: Task is not open for an evidence update
D054: The task has reached its maximum evidence revisions
D055: Only a task party can request resolution
D057: Task has not completed an inconclusive adjudication
